securityProperties: Private-beta endpoints are unavailable while the production flag is false.
Access-code verification is server-side, exact after trim, case-sensitive, and constant-time.
Pending tokens are one-use and expire after 15 minutes.
Completed access is user-bound and expires absolutely after 12 hours.
Durable failed-attempt limits are five per browser flow and twenty per network per 15 minutes.
Only keyed network and flow hashes are stored.
PUBLIC, anon, and authenticated have no direct access to private-beta tables or functions.
Founder and longer existing beta entitlements are not shortened.
Supabase PKCE session persistence uses sessionStorage.
Private-beta pending/access tokens and browser flow state use sessionStorage only.
All authenticated browser Worker callers forward the opaque admission token.
